title: San Antonio girls’ flag football team sees huge growth
summary_full: In San Antonio, girls are seizing the chance to excel in flag football, with the Alamo City Lady Roadrunners witnessing impressive growth from its inception. This emerging sport is paving the way for college scholarships and promising career paths. With flag football slated for the Olympics, aspiring athletes are presented with exciting new opportunities. The program aims to cultivate local competition to enhance player development.
